content.text: The analysis of actual grid connectivity shows that the static low-resistance path between P16 and I13-W has slightly lower resistance than the path to the closer injector, I12-W. For P14, the low-resistance connection with I15-W stands out. Grid transmissibility matters when selecting the areas to change. These paths are leads that still need to be tested by dynamic forward simulation.

The original-field baseline has completed all 2891 days and 516 report steps. The physical checks also passed at every report step. I can now calculate the formal full-period oil and water errors. Round 4 has also produced a response for the first 1281 days. I will check whether the added channel changed the individual well curves as expected, then continue full-period validation.

The full-period history-matching experiment is complete, covering **2891 days and 516 report steps**. Round 5 was selected.

- Field oil-rate and water-rate RMSE each fell from approximately **2089.43 to 544.72 m³/d**, a **73.93%** reduction.
- The combined field and well NRMSE fell from **37.98% to 11.62%**. All six wells had lower full-period error than with the original fields.

The selected match changed only porosity and permeability. The initial five-component composition retained its original normalized values and sums to 1 in every cell. The source hashes for the simulator and its key dependencies were verified.

**A substantial mismatch remains at P16.** Its end-of-history water rate was 1318 m³/d, well below the historical 2192 m³/d.
